title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Slow-stirred Arborio rice with golden mushrooms, warm broth and Parmesan.
instructions: Keep vegetable broth warm in a saucepan.
Sauté mushrooms in olive oil and 1 tbsp butter for 6–8 minutes until browned. Move them to a bowl.
Cook shallot in the same pan for 2 minutes, then stir in Arborio rice for 1 minute.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring frequently and waiting for most of each ladle to absorb; continue for about 20–25 minutes until creamy and just tender.
Stir mushrooms, remaining butter and Parmesan back in, then season and serve.
